Four independent density<=1 coordinates and an arbitrary 4x4 symmetric block with three same-sign eigenvalues of magnitude >=L have affine-quadratic density <=C_*/L, C_*=24.1830382899615... .

If one original-coordinate 4x4 principal block has three same-sign eigenvalues of magnitude >=L, arbitrary outside eigenvalues and cross-couplings preserve the same density cap C_*/L by conditioning on outside original coordinates.

If a physical m>=4 block has m-1 same-sign eigenvalues at scale L and its in-block perturbation has operator norm <=delta L, delta<1, then arbitrary outside completion has density cap C_*/((1-delta)L).
